name: Emma Vasey
title: Psychotherapist / Sexologist
description: Emma is passionate about working with the neurodiverse, LGBTQIA+, and ENM community. I focus on Relationship Issues, Sex Therapy and Trauma and PTSD. She also works with the latest science concerning trauma's impact on the brain, nervous system and attachment.
specialties: Relationship issues, Sex therapy, Trauma and PTSD, Dissociative disorders (DID), Kink and fetish, LGBTQ+, Polyamory & ENM, Sex-positive & kink friendly, Transgender issues

name: Natalia Amari
title: Social Worker / Certified Sex Therapist (AASECT)

specialties: Trauma and PTSD, Sex therapy, Somatic Experiencing, LGBTQ+, Polyamory & ENM, Sex-positive & kink friendly

title: Psychotherapist

name: Leyna Fennell
title: Psychotherapist (PACFA)
